panels.description: The granddaughter points toward a service boat while older Alex steadies crooked TJ against the dock rail. Leave upper lake space.
The terminal records the reduced withdrawal while Alex holds TJ away from the water. Leave upper terminal space.
The granddaughter holds the broken component and studies Alex. Leave upper dock space.
She places the component beside the public terminal; the theft record closes around it. Leave upper terminal space.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Across open water? With one good leg?

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Where the next person can find it.
